init.title: Entity and platform options
init.description: Choose which openHAB platforms are enabled and optionally disable noisy or helper Items. Changes to the filters are applied automatically when you press Submit.

data_description.excluded_item_prefixes: Enter one or more openHAB Item-name prefixes separated by commas. Every Item whose name starts with one of these values will be disabled in Home Assistant. Example: `nl_, nt_, nc_`
data_description.excluded_item_names: Enter one or more exact openHAB Item names separated by commas. Only Items with exactly these names will be disabled. Example: `ndim, ncurtin, nhvac`
